name: Glint
author: Erin Carter
description: Moonlight on dark open water: a horizon sits in the upper third and anisotropic specular highlights glitter across the whole sea, concentrating into a bright central moonbeam and thinning to scattered sparkle at the flanks. A slow two-swell heave rocks the glints up and down and flickers them asynchronously through zero, so the sea never resets.

params.label: Heave speed
params.effect: Speed of the swell that rocks the glints and drives their flicker, from glassy calm to a restless chop.

params.label: Glint size
params.effect: CSS-pixel height of one highlight (its width is about four times this via the anisotropic stretch).

params.label: Beam width
params.effect: Width of the bright central moonbeam — narrow gives a tight glitter lane, wide floods the whole sea evenly. Glitter always spans the full frame; this sets where it concentrates.

params.label: Glitter density
params.effect: How many glints populate the sea — low scatters a few sparse sparkles, high packs the surface with dense shimmering specular highlights.

params.label: Ripple distortion
params.effect: How strongly the sea surface refracts the glitter — 0 holds clean perspective rows, high bends them into wavy rippling streaks as if the water were stirred.
